label: copy-phase input g, late in long sequences, before certain outputs (v/h/u/j...)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost only when the fed-back input is g (98% of activation mass). Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or on any other input except a trace on v/u. Within copy-phase g inputs it is strongly gated by position: essentially silent at recall_idx <= 2, and rate rises steeply with recall_idx and with L (L=9 holds 73% of mass). It also depends on the token being output right after g, favoring v (30% of mass), then h, u, j, 3, i, g, e, b. Top activations are g followed by v or u at recall_idx 4-7 in L=9 sequences. Even with all these conditions most g inputs stay inactive, so precision is limited (about 0.35). Context beyond position and next output is not captured.
